Name: Tiny Greenhouse for Solid Foundations
Author: inmognito
Description:
[b]Overview
[/b]
A tiny greenhouse that can be bought from Robin once the player reaches level 4 farming. Holds 30 crops.

This is an adaption of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11519]Tiny Greenhouse[/url] mod for the new [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12311]Solid Foundations[/url] framework.

Please note: You will need to ensure you have at least v 1.7 of Solid Foundations if you want sprinklers to work in the greenhouses

[b]Latest additions
[/b][list]
[*]From version 2.0..0, I've added 5 more all-new skins in completely different styles and also added i18n support.
[*]From version 1.2.0, Tiny Greenhouse now has six alternative skins (with thanks to JoyceChoy for providing the Weathered recolour!)
[*]From version 1.1.0 Tiny Greenhouse now has space for up to eight fruit trees
[/list]
[b][size=4]Do you like the tiny greenhouse?  It now has a companion building, the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16246]Little Shed[/url].[/size]

Installation
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Unzip the mod file
[*]Place in mods folder
[/list]
[b]Compatibility
[/b][list]
[*]Exterior currently won't be changed by any of the building reskins. (There are now 6 basic alternate skins available when you buy the greenhouse from Robin.)
[*]Interior will be automatically reskinned by town interior reskins such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interior[/url]
[*]Compatible with the unofficial latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2917]Line Sprinklers[/url]﻿ (linked on the posts tab)
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10931]Flexible Sprinklers[/url]﻿ version 1.3.1 onwards.
[*][b]Not[/b] compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10996]Better Beehouses[/url]﻿.
[/list]
